name: TestSpecificSubclass
summary: Adds to a subclass of the system under test the methods a test needs to reach its state or override its behaviour, so that code not designed for testing can be tested.

roles.name: TestSpecificSubclass
roles.summary: A subclass of the system under test, written for the test. Note what it is not: it does not stand in for a depended-on component, so it is not a test double — it opens up the thing being tested rather than replacing something around it. That distinction is the one a reader most often gets wrong.
